interpretation.why: The new route executes through the productized runner with clean metadata, but it is slower than the old route on both the inner hot metric and runner-inclusive metric.
interpretation.noise_boundary: The inner hot regression is about 7.5 microseconds, smaller than the M9 15.4 microsecond frozen-row delta; the runner-inclusive overhead is much larger and should be treated as a real productized-runner cost unless reduced.

next_decision.candidate_next_work: Reduce generic prepared_execution_session_runner overhead or retarget to a Set-A family where productized-runner overhead amortizes across more work.

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Classify M11 as productized-runner coverage pass but performance fail.
goal_level_decision_audit.if_yes_what_actions_made_it_foolish: The foolish action would be to call clean metadata a performance success or to hide the runner-inclusive slowdown.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_there_another_path: Yes: keep tuning this route immediately. That would be premature without review because the focused POD shows the current local productized wrapper adds overhead.
goal_level_decision_audit.can_i_try_a_different_path_now: Yes: record the negative result, seek review, and decide whether to optimize generic runner overhead or retarget a different Set-A family.
